integrity: The unrestricted theorem is supported by an explicit private-neighbor counting and matching-cut proof. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only maximum-cardinality inclusion-minimal dominating vertex sets of simple circular prisms with at least three rungs are enumerated.

The 2013 regular-graph equality-classification source and 1999 prism-related article could not be read in full; the available abstracts leave a residual possibility of overlapping structural descriptions.
The finite verification through ten rungs is corroboration rather than a proof for all sizes.
title: Four-periodic classification of upper-dominating sets in prism graphs
